Set up on the printer's computer

Run one of these on the computer next to the printer, such as a Raspberry Pi with CUPS. It asks whether the printer is a CUPS queue or a network (IPP) printer, lists the printers it finds, and suggests a name and slug. The printer appears in the list when setup finishes.
Works until . Anyone with the command can add a printer until then.

Print from your phone in seconds
No app, no account, no cables. Scan the code at the printer, pick your documents, and pick up your pages.
Point your phone’s camera at the code posted next to the printer and tap the link that appears.
Add PDFs or photos, give the job a name you’ll recognize, and set the number of copies.
Tap Print and your job goes straight to that printer. Pick it up from the tray in a moment.
No. Everything happens in your phone’s web browser — there is nothing to install and no sign-in.

PDFs and photos (JPEG, PNG, and iPhone HEIC). You can send several documents at once and choose how many copies of each.
